name: map
description: Spec-to-bead correlation layer. Owns the mapping file (.bead-map.json) that links spec node IDs to bead IDs with typed metadata. Provides CRUD operations, context resolution, and CLI query interface.

requirements.title: Store mapping records
requirements.description: Read/write .bead-map.json. Each record links a spec node ID to a bead ID with structured metadata: module name, component/section name, content file path, spec hash at time of mapping, and bead type.

requirements.title: Query mappings via CLI
requirements.description: spex map get <record-id> returns structured JSON with module, component, content path, and metadata. spex map list shows all mappings. spex map context <record-id> resolves full spec context. All four invocations are declared as api nodes — the parent `spex map` and its three children — and each names MapCommand in provided_by alongside the worker it drives: MappingStore for get and list, ContextResolver for context. A declared name carries no argument placeholder: the api is `spex map get`, not `spex map get <record-id>`, because the name must be the string a caller types and must survive corpus tokenization unchanged. Declaring the children alongside the parent is also what keeps the parent retirable — the removal-time name check discards hits that a longer live name already covers, so the mentions of `spex map` that belong to `spex map get`, `spex map list` or `spex map context` are never counted against the bare parent.

requirements.title: Validate mapping file against schema
requirements.description: MappingStore validates .bead-map.json against the bead-map JSON Schema on load. Invalid files produce a clear error before any CRUD operation.

requirements.title: Resolve full spec context from record
requirements.description: Given a record ID, deterministically resolve all spec files needed to implement the component: architecture file (from record content_file), test_sections whose describes array contains the component ID, and data_flows whose uses array contains the component ID. Returns a single JSON blob with all file paths.

components.name: MappingStore
components.description: Read/write .bead-map.json. CRUD operations on mapping records. Each record links a spec node identity hash to a bead ID with structured metadata including bead_type field. The `spec_node_id` field is the same 12-char hex identity hash that the merkle tree uses as a key, so impact and apply look up records by that hash with no translation. Supports record updates for obsolete+create flows.

components.name: MapCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex map. Wires MappingStore and ContextResolver to serve queries and context resolution.

components.name: ContextResolver
components.description: Given a mapping record, reads the module.json and resolves all spec files for the component: the arch file, the test_sections and data_flows that name it, and the module file itself. Looks up the component by matching the record's spec_node_id (an identity hash) against the ids declared in module.json — no integer parsing from the spec_node_id, no path decomposition. Pure function over spec directory — deterministic and cacheable.

data_flows.name: Bead creation mapping flow
data_flows.description: How a record id travels from emit to the tracker and back. Emit reads MappingStore to stamp each create op with a spex:<record-id> idempotency label, the adapter applies that label to the bead it creates, and ingest materialises the mapping record at exactly that id from the changeset and the receipts. Skills query mappings via MapCommand.

apis.name: spex map get
apis.description: Get a mapping record by ID

apis.name: spex map context
apis.description: Resolve full spec context for a mapping record
